provenance.notes: Limits unknown: Odoo's external API reference states no rate limit nor quota (Odoo Online databases have been seen answering 429, no figure published); a self-hosted database's limits are its own. Commercial declared as 'contract': on Odoo Online the external API is only available on the Custom pricing plan (not One App Free nor Standard); a self-hosted Community edition is free. An API key is a user's, lasts three months at most (rotate it), up to 10 keys a user programmatically. XML-RPC and JSON-RPC are removed in Odoo 22 (fall 2028) / Online 21.1 (winter 2027); this package calls JSON-2 (/json/2). Storage, caching and redistribution: the reference does not say.
